purpose: Receptor-binding, trafficking, and early STAT6 signaling EDA for the first QSP model phase.

citation.title: Instructive roles for agonist binding parameters in determining the functional bandwidth of cytokine receptor signaling

files.role: Author-reported Table 2 and Table 3 kinetic parameter sets.
Author-reported Table 1 model estimates and initial condition.
Approximate bar heights from Figures 5C and 7D.

digitization.method: Color-segmented bar-height extraction with axis calibration.
Color-segmented bar-height extraction with a separate axis calibration per variant panel.

evidence_policy.author_reported_measurement: Numerical value transcribed from an author table and described as an experimental rate.
evidence_policy.author_reported_model_parameter: Numerical value used by the authors for a simulation; not necessarily independently measured.
evidence_policy.author_reported_model_estimate: Estimated parameter in the authors' mechanistic model.
evidence_policy.digitized_from_published_raster: Approximate value recovered from a raster figure; suitable for EDA and weak calibration constraints, not a substitute for raw data.

known_limitations: The repository does not contain raw FCS files or author-supplied point-level pSTAT6 tables.
Digitized bar heights omit the plotted dispersion bars because their statistical definition is not stated in the main-figure legend.
The Figure 7D ligand concentration is not stated in the main-figure legend and is left missing rather than inferred.
C4, D7, and C10 kinetic rates in Table 2 are model-scenario values: the paper states that koff was calculated from measured KD and a common kon was imposed.
Derived KD and residence half-life values are transformations, not additional observations.
